# The NPDM declares no system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled must be false: nninitStartup (main+0x5b6984) then sets a heap of pool − used memory (2 MB aligned) and hands it
# to StandardAllocator; with virtual address memory it asks for a 60 GB address region instead. The 4 GB layout with a 3328 MB heap region: SetHeapSize asks for 3.14 GB.
# Within it the game creates 1.5 GB of NVN memory pools in its first 25 s (about 1.3 GB resident at the title on the Mac)
